author: Cosmo

honesty.statement: SEEDED look-hints only. A designed look, never a measurement, never live quantum data. The engine own skyAt, atmosphere, nightFactor, sea-state waveHeightAt and boomState WIN; this pack may be read or ignored. Previews are flat data drawings; nothing here was tested on a phone, in three.js, or on the live site.
honesty.mood_targets: Studio 27..30 are mood targets only, not engine numbers; no boom shell target exists so boom ramps are generic
honesty.no_hud_text: no HUD or label strings; identifiers only; Emeth owns words

color_space: hex are sRGB (piecewise); all blends in LINEAR light; linear fields are authoritative

class_mapping.airless_rule: thin airless worlds have no dusk and no haze rim

temperature_tilt.rule: tilt = clamp(log10(T/350)/0.60206, -1, 1); mix toward warm if tilt>0 else cool; mix = max_mix * |tilt|

hue_rotation.rule: deg = (hue - 0.5) * 2 * max_deg; rotate about the grey axis in linear light

const_block.note: rule order copied from universe/planets/planet_assignments.json; class mapping thin/mid/thick = moon/desert/temperate, ice and volcanic are mid variants (as in skypack)

mood_targets.label: MOOD TARGETS ONLY: block-mean pixel samples of Studio 27..30_visual_life_*.jpg, not engine numbers, not measurements of the engine
read_as: 31: bright white core, cream ring shell with a teal inner edge and violet-grey shadow, lighting sky shore and water; orbit inset shows a cream flash bloom on the sunward side
32: golden-hour depth, each ridge hazier toward the horizon in distinct bands, a golden valley mist bank, a glowing golden orbit rim
turquoise water is the hero on the temperate class
same world at orbit and ground
a storm cell on the horizon darkens sky and sea toward slate
no Earth coastline is copied; nothing here encodes a coastline

function.name: palette(planet)
steps: for each role: c = lerp(c, warm|cool, max_mix * |tilt|); c = hue_rotate(c, deg); hero role uses the smaller max_mix and max_deg
weights = base + k_water*(water - water_ref), clip>=0, renormalise; if weight[hero_role] < hero_floor lift it to the floor and shrink the rest pro rata

biome_const.rule: c = desat(biome_rgb, sat_mul[role]); c = lerp(c, class_day_horizon_sky, sky_mix); c = lerp(c, type hero, hero_mix). Water biomes take the type water colour (hero on temperate) instead of the biome rgb. Mood: rock and grass stay muted.

SAME_WORLD.rule: orbit view and first-person view read the same palette(planet) output; the swatches in same_world_check.png draw both from it

fpdepth_json.use: numbers referenced, never edited: fog near/far/exp2_density/haze_to_sky per class and time, far_fog_mix_cap, saturation_by_distance_m

const_block.haze_curve: f(d) = min(far_mix_cap, 1 - exp(-(d * exp2_density)^2)), exp2_density from fpdepth.json FOG.classes[class][time]; distant land: c = lerp(c, haze_colour, f)
const_block.limb_thickness_note: atmosphere <0.05 is airless: thickness 0, no rim, no dusk (rule shared with planet_assignments). thickness is a fraction of the planet radius; the engine atmosphere value wins
const_block.limb_alpha_driver: cosine between the sun direction and the limb normal; the engine terminatorWeight / nightFactor edges decide the real fall-off
const_block.fog_density_rule: mul = 1 + a*moisture01 + b*storm01 + c*moisture01*storm01; fog far_m = base far_m / mul (near the same); thin = none (airless, 1.0 and fog stays disabled)
const_block.storm_haze_note: thick: slate (mood 29: horizon #687B90, cloud #2B4A66); mid: dust-storm brown. mix = storm_haze_mix_max * storm01

day.note: airless: no haze, no dusk (thin class)

night.note: airless: no haze, no dusk (thin class)

thin.note: airless: no limb rim, no haze rim

mid.source: skypack SKY.classes.mid.states day/golden_dusk horizon blended 0.35 toward zenith
mid.golden_hour_rule: rim = lerp(rim_colour.day, golden_hour_rim_colour, mix(sun elevation sin at the lit limb)); sunward limb only; Studio 32 mood hint, engine skyAt wins
mid.golden_hour_driver: sun elevation at the limb (engine sun direction) and planet atmosphere value

thick.source: skypack SKY.classes.thick.states day/golden_dusk horizon blended 0.35 toward zenith
thick.golden_hour_rule: rim = lerp(rim_colour.day, golden_hour_rim_colour, mix(sun elevation sin at the lit limb)); sunward limb only; Studio 32 mood hint, engine skyAt wins
thick.golden_hour_driver: sun elevation at the limb (engine sun direction) and planet atmosphere value

drivers.haze_by_class: engine atmosphere value (uAtmo / sky-state byAtmo) picks the class; distance from the camera; skyAt toward the horizon wins for colour
drivers.limb_rim: planet atmosphere value + sun direction vs limb normal (terminatorWeight edges); orbit view only
drivers.fog_density_mul_grid: F.moisture (world-field cell at the camera) and F.storm (storm tension, sea-state seaFrom storm)

ridge_steps.label: Studio 32 mood hint, SEEDED; fpdepth fog density wins
ridge_steps.rule: each ridge band takes quant_haze_mix (six visible steps) toward haze_colour; lighter and less saturated with distance; use the smooth haze_by_class curve when steps are off
ridge_steps.driver: camera distance to each ridge, sun elevation (golden hour: low sun) and atmosphere value (thick class)

valley_mist.label: Studio 32 mood hint, SEEDED
valley_mist.driver: F.moisture (world-field cell), sun elevation (skyAt sun direction) and nightFactor; terrain depth from land-state relief

const_block.age_cap_note: crest cap = sea-state SEA.foamLifeS (2 s) x 4 ticks/s = 8 ticks (engine number). shore 24 and storm_lingering 40 ticks are OUR OWN numbers, not standards: foam that travels and lingers
const_block.age_fade_rule: alpha = table(age/age_cap) * birth_alpha; age >= cap = 0 (fully faded by the cap)
const_block.birth_rule: whitecap = clamp(whitecapStorm*storm + whitecapWind*wind01, 0, 1) (sea-state seaFrom; whitecapStorm=1.10 whitecapWind=0.12); zero wind and zero storm gives whitecap 0 so birth 0
const_block.advection_dir: sea.dir (atan2 of the engine wind), i.e. downwind; foam carries across the wave field

driver.birth: sea-state seaFrom storm + wind (whitecap) at wave crests; shoreline swell for shore foam
driver.advection: sea.dir and sea.wind from the CST wind (motionParams wind)

foam.driver: birth: sea-state seaFrom storm + wind (whitecap) at wave crests; shoreline swell for shore foam | age: engine tick (t = ticks / 4 s) | advection: sea.dir and sea.wind from the CST wind (motionParams wind)

const_block.wind_ms_note: the engine has no m/s: wind01 = |wind| / SEA.windRef (0.6). m/s column = wind01 x 25, a presentation hint, OUR OWN number, not a standard
const_block.rule: half_width_deg = skypack glitter half_width_deg_at_rough_0p20(sun_elev) * half_width_mul(wind01) * (roughness / 0.20)^0.5; storm roughness comes from sea.chop (existing); energy spread: peak x peak_intensity_mul
const_block.driver: sun elevation (engine sky/sun direction) + sea.wind (wind01) + sea.chop; widens with wind, narrows when calm

glitter.driver: sun elevation (engine sky/sun direction) + sea.wind (wind01) + sea.chop; widens with wind, narrows when calm

const_block.rule: I(depth, sun) = peak * exp(-depth / decay_m) * (1 - smoothstep(0.6*cutoff_m, cutoff_m, depth)) * sun_gate(sin elev); night = night_mul
const_block.phase_lock: caustic cell phase is the SAME wave function: waveHeightAt(sea, dir, t) (sea-state.mjs); the cell drift follows sea.dir; no private clock
const_block.driver: waveHeightAt phase (engine tick) + sun elevation + water depth

EVENTS.label: MOOD-HINTED ramps (Studio 31 samples, mood only, not engine numbers) blended with boom.mjs own tint constants. boomState().colorRGB (from the real star temperature) WINS. SEEDED (stepped test universe), never recorded history
EVENTS.phase_names_source: lib/universe/boom.mjs boomState phases (read from the repo copy; sha256 recorded)

timing.note: phase edges and life are boom.mjs numbers (BOOM.flashEnd/shellEnd/fadeEnd/lifeTicks); seconds = ticks / 4 (sea-state engine clock). our own numbers below, not standards

fp_sky.driver: boomState(star, eventTick, tick): phase, u, intensity; sky term boomSkyTerm = min(skyCap, intensity*lum/d^2*skyK) * (1 - dayPale*sunUp), d in AU (1/d^2)

orbit_globe_flash.driver: boomState phase and intensity, same tick as the FP sky; light on a globe scales by the same 1/d^2 term (boom.mjs); near side only via terminatorWeight

sky_term_example.label: illustration of the engine formula applied to star-0 (recorded star numbers), not a prediction; engine boomSkyTerm wins

mood_31.label: Studio 31 mood hints, SEEDED; the engine 1/d^2 sky term and the phase edges are boom.mjs and are not changed here; the engine wins

shell_radial.note: bright cream ring, teal inner edge, violet-grey shadow side; draw the inner edge from the ramp at t-0.3 mixed with inner_edge_colour

lights_surfaces.rule: surface water = lerp(water, boom light colour, mix(boomSkyTerm-driven intensity)); shore and sand lit by the same term; the far side stays dark

orbit_inset_bloom.rule: bloom centred on the limb nearest the boom bearing; radius follows boomState phase; brightness = light_gain table x the engine 1/d^2 term

mood_31.driver: boomState(star, eventTick, tick) phase and intensity; boom bearing; boomSkyTerm 1/d^2 (boom.mjs) for strength; near side via terminatorWeight

orbit_cell.driver: F.storm (storm tension) and the storm cell position from the engine; same cell the FP sky shows

fp_horizon.driver: F.storm and the storm cell bearing from the engine

wet_earth_ahead.colour_rule: ground = base * lerp(1, 0.58, wet), chroma x lerp(1, 1.12, wet); wet is the engine wetnessTarget(moisture, baseline); this table is only the visual lead-in
wet_earth_ahead.driver: land-state wetnessTarget(moisture, baseline) / wetnessStep, moisture field around the storm cell

landfall.driver: F.storm tension crossing thresholds (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75) of the engine value; no private timer: ticks are counted from the engine tick the threshold was crossed
